entry.title: Abdullah Azzam Brigades (AAB)
entry.summary: The Abdullah Azzam Brigades; the Ziyad al-Jarrah Battalions; and the Marwan Hadid Brigades.
entry.content: The AAB is an Al Qaida affiliated militant group.

entry.title: Abu Nidal Organization (ANO)
entry.summary: Fatah Revolutionary Council, Black June, Arab Revolutionary Brigades.
entry.content: From the mid-1970s to the early 1990s, the ANO was one of the most feared groups.
